spec.title: TVX-SKYNET External Dependencies
spec.description: SOC view of 41 external dependencies: customer-critical integrations, CRMs, payments, carriers, internal tools, active incidents and collection coverage.

spec.title: External dependency status
spec.description: Worst effective state across all enabled external providers. Stale providers are treated as unknown.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE effective_status
        WHEN 'operational' THEN 0
        WHEN 'maintenance' THEN 1
        WHEN 'unknown' THEN 2
        WHEN 'degraded' THEN 3
        WHEN 'partial_outage' THEN 4
        WHEN 'major_outage' THEN 5
        ELSE 2
    END), 2) AS "External dependency status"
FROM external_status.provider_current;

spec.title: Issues now — provider, service and incident
spec.description: One row per unresolved provider incident, with the affected service and exact incident title. Provider outages without a published incident get an explicit summary. Unreported manual sources and collector failures are shown in provider state below.

spec.rawSql:
WITH issues AS (
    SELECT
        provider.name AS "Provider",
        COALESCE(affected.names, 'Provider-wide / not specified') AS "Affected service",
        COALESCE(incident.title, 'Provider reports ' || replace(provider.effective_status, '_', ' ')) AS "Issue",
        COALESCE(incident.impact, provider.effective_status) AS "Impact",
        COALESCE(incident.lifecycle, 'provider_status') AS "Stage",
        COALESCE(incident.provider_updated_at, provider.last_success_at) AS "Updated",
        COALESCE(incident.source_url, NULLIF(catalog.status_url, '')) AS "Source"
    FROM external_status.provider_current AS provider
    JOIN external_status.source_catalog AS catalog ON catalog.id = provider.id
    LEFT JOIN external_status.active_incidents AS incident ON incident.provider_id = provider.id
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT string_agg(component.name, ', ' ORDER BY component.name) AS names
        FROM external_status.components AS component
        WHERE component.provider_id = provider.id
          AND component.active
          AND ((incident.external_id IS NOT NULL AND component.external_id = ANY(incident.affected_component_ids))
               OR (incident.external_id IS NULL AND component.current_status IN ('degraded', 'partial_outage', 'major_outage', 'maintenance')))
    ) AS affected ON TRUE
    WHERE incident.external_id IS NOT NULL
       OR provider.effective_status IN ('degraded', 'partial_outage', 'major_outage', 'maintenance')
), display_rows AS (
    SELECT * FROM issues
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'All providers', ''::text, 'No reported service incidents', 'operational', ''::text, NULL::timestamptz, NULL::text
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM issues)
)
SELECT * FROM display_rows
ORDER BY CASE "Impact" WHEN 'major_outage' THEN 5 WHEN 'partial_outage' THEN 4 WHEN 'degraded' THEN 3
    WHEN 'unknown' THEN 2 WHEN 'maintenance' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC, "Provider", "Updated" DESC;

spec.title: All providers — status and collection gaps
spec.description: Current provider condition, freshness, and last collector error.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT p.name AS "Provider", p.category AS "Category", p.effective_status AS "Status",
    c.collection_mode AS "Collection", p.stale AS "Stale", p.last_success_at AS "Last successful poll",
    p.consecutive_failures AS "Failures", COALESCE(p.last_error, '') AS "Last error"
FROM external_status.provider_current p JOIN external_status.source_catalog c USING (id)
ORDER BY CASE p.category WHEN 'customer-critical' THEN 0 WHEN 'carriers' THEN 1 WHEN 'crm' THEN 2
    WHEN 'second-tier' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, p.name;

spec.title: Incident details and source links
spec.description: Current unresolved incidents and the latest lifecycle reported by each provider.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    source.name AS "Provider",
    incident.title AS "Incident",
    incident.lifecycle AS "Lifecycle",
    incident.impact AS "Impact",
    incident.started_at AS "Started",
    incident.provider_updated_at AS "Updated",
    incident.source_url AS "Source"
FROM external_status.active_incidents AS incident
JOIN external_status.sources AS source ON source.id = incident.provider_id
WHERE source.enabled
ORDER BY incident.provider_updated_at DESC;

spec.title: Poll reliability
spec.description: Collector success rate during the selected dashboard range. Manual sources record attempts to read vendor reports, not network probes. Missing credentials appear as failed authenticated collection.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    source_id AS "Source",
    COUNT(*) AS "Checks",
    ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN succeeded THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 1) AS "Success rate",
    MAX(checked_at) AS "Last check"
FROM external_status.poll_attempts
WHERE $__timeFilter(checked_at)
GROUP BY source_id
ORDER BY source_id;

spec.title: Provider state timeline
spec.description: Provider condition over the selected time range. Numeric values are mapped back to normalized service states. Rows represent successful observations only; gaps and current freshness must be checked in provider state.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    observed_at AS "time",
    provider_id AS metric,
    CASE status
        WHEN 'operational' THEN 0
        WHEN 'maintenance' THEN 1
        WHEN 'unknown' THEN 2
        WHEN 'degraded' THEN 3
        WHEN 'partial_outage' THEN 4
        WHEN 'major_outage' THEN 5
        ELSE 2
    END::double precision AS value
FROM external_status.provider_observations
WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at)
ORDER BY observed_at;

spec.title: Component state
spec.description: Current status of the configured components for the selected providers.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    source.name AS "Provider",
    component.name AS "Component",
    component.current_status AS "Status",
    component.provider_updated_at AS "Provider updated"
FROM external_status.components AS component
JOIN external_status.sources AS source ON source.id = component.provider_id
WHERE source.enabled AND component.active
  AND component.provider_id ~ '^${provider:regex}$'
ORDER BY source.name, component.name;

spec.title: Recent poll attempts
spec.description: Recent successful and failed collection attempts for the selected providers.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    checked_at AS "Checked",
    source_id AS "Source",
    succeeded AS "Succeeded",
    COALESCE(error, '') AS "Error"
FROM external_status.poll_attempts
WHERE $__timeFilter(checked_at)
  AND source_id ~ '^${provider:regex}$'
ORDER BY checked_at DESC
LIMIT 100;

spec.title: Dependency coverage and status sources
spec.description: What each dependency affects, how status is collected and where coverage is incomplete. Manual and credential-dependent sources stay unknown until reporting is configured.

spec.title: Customer-critical dependency status
spec.description: Worst state for customer-critical services and carriers. Unknown includes missing tenant credentials and unreported or expired manual statuses.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE effective_status
        WHEN 'operational' THEN 0
        WHEN 'maintenance' THEN 1
        WHEN 'unknown' THEN 2
        WHEN 'degraded' THEN 3
        WHEN 'partial_outage' THEN 4
        WHEN 'major_outage' THEN 5
        ELSE 2
    END), 2) AS "Customer-critical status"
FROM external_status.provider_current WHERE category IN ('customer-critical', 'carriers');

options.content: Start with **Issues now**: each row shows the provider, affected service and exact incident title. Click the source link for the provider’s updates. No reported incidents does not prove every integration is healthy: **All providers** shows missing credentials, manual reports, stale data and failed collection. Manual reports expire after 24 hours. Microsoft tenant health requires Graph app credentials. Provider selection filters component and poll-detail panels; summaries and current issues cover all enabled providers.
